version: 2
seeds:
- name: wait_milestones
  description: 'Metric 3: moments between GTA V and GTA 6, one row per milestone, each dated to a UTC
    day and carrying one public source. is_editorial marks the ones the chart draws.'
  config:
    column_types:
      event_date: date
      is_editorial: boolean
  columns:
  - name: milestone_id
    description: Slug, e.g. black_hole_image.
    data_tests:
    - unique
    - not_null
  - name: event_date
    description: UTC day the event happened.
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: date_precision
    description: day, or month when only the month is certain.
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - day
          - month
  - name: category
    description: Theme of the milestone; rockstar marks the Rockstar nods.
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - ai
          - computing
          - culture
          - health
          - humanity
          - physics
          - planet
          - release
          - rockstar
          - space
  - name: tier
    description: anchor (the two releases), hero (headline moments) or long.
    data_tests:
    - accepted_values:
        arguments:
          values:
          - anchor
          - hero
          - long
  - name: is_editorial
    description: 'True for the editorial milestones: the ones drawn on the Metric 3 chart.'
    data_tests:
    - not_null
  - name: title
    description: What happened, in a sentence.
  - name: chart_label
    description: Short label for the chart.
  - name: why
    description: Why it is on the list.
  - name: source_url
    description: One public source for the date.

-- Metric 3: each milestone of the wait, placed on the running total of world real output.
-- output_by_then is the running total through the day before the event: "by the time it
-- happened, the world had made $X since GTA V". GTA V's own release day has made nothing yet
-- since GTA V, so it reads 0; any other milestone outside the wait reads NULL.
with milestones as (
    select * from {{ ref('wait_milestones') }}
),

daily as (
    select * from {{ ref('fct_world_output_daily') }}
),

wait as (
    select arg_max(cumulative_output, output_day) as wait_output
    from daily
)

select
    milestones.milestone_id,
    milestones.event_date,
    milestones.date_precision,
    milestones.category,
    milestones.tier,
    milestones.is_editorial,
    milestones.title,
    milestones.chart_label,
    milestones.why,
    milestones.source_url,
    case
        when milestones.event_date = cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date) then 0
        else daily.cumulative_output
    end as output_by_then,
    output_by_then / wait.wait_output as share_of_wait_output,
    datediff('day', cast('{{ var('gta_v_date', '2013-09-17') }}' as date), milestones.event_date) as days_since_gta_v,
    datediff('day', milestones.event_date, cast('{{ var('gta_6_date', '2026-11-19') }}' as date)) as days_to_gta_6
from milestones
left join wait on true
left join daily on daily.output_day = milestones.event_date - 1

declarations.description: Metric 3: the milestones of the wait between GTA V and GTA 6, each with the world real output made since GTA V by the day before it. One row per milestone.

population.rule: Every milestone in the wait_milestones seed.

tier.description: anchor (the two releases), hero (headline moments) or long.

is_editorial.description: True for the editorial milestones: the ones drawn on the Metric 3 chart.

output_by_then.null_rule: NULL when the event falls outside the wait or the running total is unavailable.
output_by_then.description: World real output made from GTA V's release through the day before the event, constant 2015 US$.

share_of_wait_output.description: output_by_then over the whole wait's output: how far through the wait, in output.

assumptions.decision: Which day a milestone's output is read on
assumptions.chosen: the running total through the day before the event
assumptions.detail: user: Metric 3 plan; avoids arguing about events late in the UTC day
user: Metric 3 plan; the day before GTA V lies outside the wait, and nothing has been made since GTA V yet

assumptions.chosen: the nine flagged is_editorial: comet, AlphaGo, RDR2, black hole, vaccine, ChatGPT, GTA VI trailer, Claude Code, Artemis II
assumptions.detail: user named the milestones to keep on the chart and asked for Claude Code

assumptions.chosen: 2025-02-24, the research-preview launch beside Claude 3.7 Sonnet
assumptions.detail: first public release; general availability (2025-05-22) is kept in why
